MAYA (beat): You kept it.
THEO: Of course I kept it.
MAYA, quietly: I thought you'd throw it out.
THEO: I almost did. (beat) Then I didn't.
She takes the ring out of the box.
MAYA: It still fits.
THEO (not looking at her): It was always going to.
MAYA: Theo. Look at me.
THEO: I can't. (beat) Not yet.
